task.title: Repair dev deploy remote assembly without staging-only variables

not_changing: staging-live target validation and fail-closed rules in validate_target_selection
shared dev environment lease or release admission policy

acceptance_mapping.fix_dev_remote_command_assembly: scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh safely expands STAGING_EXEC_HEALTH_URL and STAGING_BFF_CORS_ORIGINS (as well as DEV_BFF_* sibling variables in staging) using default-empty parameter expansion ${VAR:-} in ssh_bash command_prefix assembly, preventing unbound variable errors under bash -u when deploying dev with staging variables unset.
acceptance_mapping.preserve_staging_live_and_retired_target: validate_target_selection retains strict required-variable and retired-target identity enforcement without fabricated staging defaults.
acceptance_mapping.reproduce_and_prove_via_stubbed_ssh: Executable tests reproduce real assembly beyond dry-run with all staging variables unset using a stubbed SSH boundary, capturing and asserting exact selected dev target (host and user), exact command prefix, and script payload delivered via stdin without invoking any real remote.
acceptance_mapping.contract_tests_and_rejection_tests: Explicit-empty and retired-target rejection tests are preserved and pass cleanly, alongside new beyond-dry-run tests for both dev and staging-live environments.
acceptance_mapping.runtime_safety: No hosted runtime mutation is performed; integration verification and redeploy remain owned by root GPT-6 Astra.

review_decision.note: Independent reviewer must validate the frozen PR head, test coverage, and this manifest before approval.
